title: Topic 11: Shopping - Reading
description: Two short texts with three questions each.
canDoStatement: Buy things, ask prices, sizes, quantities

readingBlock.readingText:
TEXT A - Shop notice format
MODA MIA - YOUR SHOP IN PORTO
OPEN: Monday to Saturday, nine o'clock to seven o'clock
CLOSED on Sunday
* Small bags ...... ten dollars
* Big bags ........ twenty-five dollars
* Books and photo frames too!
Pay by card or cash.
This Saturday: all small bags five dollars!

TEXT B - reading at this dial)
Zia:   Are you at the market, Bruno?
Bruno: Yes! It is very big - there are bags, books
       and food!
Zia:   Can you buy apples for me, please?
Bruno: Yes! Apples are one dollar today - very cheap.
Zia:   Great! And a big bag of rice, please.
Bruno: OK! I pay cash - this market is cash only!

readingQuestions.correctAnswer: A shop notice with hours and prices

readingQuestions.question: How much are the small bags THIS SATURDAY?
What does Zia ask Bruno?
options: To buy things for her at the market
readingQuestions.correctAnswer: To buy things for her at the market

options: Cash - the market is cash only
readingQuestions.correctAnswer: Cash - the market is cash only
